description: This file contains business logic for managing cart and order operations in a Django e-commerce project, including adding/removing items and handling cart state.

classes.name: CartResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a cart operation, including message and redirect info.

methods.name: CartResult add_item_to_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item)
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's cart, creating an order if necessary, and handling quantity updates.

methods.name: CartResult remove_item_from_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item)
methods.description: Removes an item entirely from the user's cart if present.

methods.name: CartResult remove_single_quantity_from_cart( *, user: get_user_model(), item: Item )
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of an item by one or removes it if quantity reaches zero.

ctags.name: add_item_to_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def add_item_to_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item) -> CartResult:$/

ctags.name: remove_item_from_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def remove_item_from_cart(*, user: get_user_model(), item: Item) -> CartResult:$/
